text_block_list.name: Photographer
text_block_list.text: Aaand please look right into the lens. Great, thank you!

text_block_list.name: Photographer
text_block_list.text: Okay, give me a moment to check the shot!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today, I'm accompanying Fine Motion on a photo shoot to advertise a photography studio. The theme of the shoot is "a wedding in the midst of nature."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Apparently, we're going to take some pictures in a forest next. Hehe, a woodland wedding sounds so wonderful. ♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: From the sounds of it, it's going to take some time to set up. Why don't we go for a stroll in the meantime?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Mmm, the air is so fresh! And the greenery is beautiful—it reminds me of the forests back home in Ireland!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Maybe if we keep walking, we'll stumble across a fairy door that'll transport us there.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Glimmer…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: What's the matter, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I tell Fine Motion about the strange lights I glimpsed flickering near her. Maybe I'm just seeing things…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Lights? I didn't see anything, though…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Oh my… Hehe. It must be the fairies playing tricks on you. ♪
choice_data_list: Fairies? Surely that's a little unlikely…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Well, who's to say? Look around. This forest is simply wonderful! It wouldn't be too surprising if a few fairies lived here, would it?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Fairies love places with beautiful trees and clear, flowing waters, you see. People tell lots of stories about fairies in Ireland, you know.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Tales of fairies helping out with the housework at night, or showing people the way to hidden gold.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: But some fairies love to play pranks, and I've heard that they even kidnap people! ♪
choice_data_list: I wouldn't want you to get kidnapped, Fine.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, don't you worry, Trainer. No fairy is going to kidnap me.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I'm rather good at negotiating, you know. So even if I were to cross paths with a fairy…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I would extend them every courtesy and try to request their assistance for the good of the Irish public. ♪
choice_data_list: A fairy would make a great ally.
A fairy would make a great ally.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Well, if those lights you saw really were fairies…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I'm sure this next shoot will be quite wonderful indeed! ♪

text_block_list.name: Photographer
text_block_list.text: Ready when you are, Fine Motion!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Splendid! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The forest photo shoot proceeds without a hitch. Until…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hehe…

text_block_list.name: Photographer
text_block_list.text: Okay, now to look over the shots!

text_block_list.name: Photographer
text_block_list.text: W-wait, what's this?!

text_block_list.name: Photographer
text_block_list.text: It might be the exposure, but there's this radiant glow surrounding Fine Motion…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Has the photo turned out wonderfully?

text_block_list.name: Photographer
text_block_list.text: Yes, it's absolutely magical! This picture… It's practically a miracle!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The photo shows Fine Motion bathed in a shimmering glow, and the poster it's used for goes on to garner quite a lot of attention!

text_block_list.name: Photographer
text_block_list.text: That expression—it's simply wonderful! Now, just hold it for a moment… Hm? No, not now!

text_block_list.name: Photographer
text_block_list.text: Why won't the shutter close?! I can't miss out on a shot like this!
choice_data_list: You don't think… a mischievous fairy could be on the loose?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hmm, I wonder. Well, I'm not sure, but shall I give them a scolding just in case?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Messing people about is absolutely not allowed. If you play one too many pranks, I might just sprinkle some water on you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fine Motion addresses her surroundings with a theatrical tone. And, perhaps thanks to her, there are no more technical issues for the rest of the shoot.
